display_title: The Lower Part of the Green Color
description:
Gyu-Rye, a second-year student at Yeonriji High School. He is at an age where he should be interested in love and good alarms, but what Gyu-Rye wants most is a lottery ticket to escape from a family that does not pay attention to him. Is he trying to grant his wish? One day, two people appear in front of Gyu-Rye. A game buddy and affectionate son, and a boy who claims to be Han Kang-Rin's childhood friend and makes him feel bad, Ok So-Han. One of these two is a lover from a past life 70 years ago who has a 'shield', and the other is an avenger who has a grudge from a past life with a 'spear'. 

A story of three people's entangled relationships that have continued for over 70 years, with their memories of past and present lives mixed up in a mess.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
